Apparent Indiscriminate Drone Strikes

Tombonkore, Bandiagara Region, August 19

On the morning of August 19, an apparent military drone released munition on civilians gathered at the cattle market in the village of Tombonkore, Kilimpo area, Bandiagara region, killing six men and injuring at least 20 others.
